description.value: Rainbow Market is a convenience store located on Prince Rupert Boulevard in the North Coast region of British Columbia. Sitting along a key coastal corridor near Prince Rupert, it serves as a local stop for everyday supplies. Touring cyclists passing through this remote stretch of BC will find it a useful resupply point in an area with limited services.

The linked Facebook page returned only a 'Temporarily Blocked' error on all subpages, yielding no usable business content — so all amenity answers rely solely on OSM tags. The shop=convenience tag supports a 'Basic groceries' value of true, as that categorization directly implies the sale of everyday grocery items; all other amenities remain null for lack of evidence.
